tasks.answer: FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen — the batch compensation workspace for standard, special and review steps. Import from '@/features/flight-delay-compensation/batch-detail-screen'. Required prop: batchId (string). It needs query, auth and router providers and handles offline/conflict states.

There is no dedicated 'special passenger' list variant in the catalog. The traveler booking list is bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen, imported from '@/features/traveler-bookings/booking-list-screen'. Required prop: navigate ((options: NavigateOptions) => void | Promise<void>); optional: initialStatus?: number. It is a paginated traveler booking list with search and filters, so special-passenger filtering must be done through those filters — there is no specialTraveler/special-passenger prop or dedicated variant (verified via get: the prop schema exposes only initialStatus and navigate).

UiPasswordInput, import from '@/components/ui/form'. Required props: showLabel and hideLabel (labels for the show/hide toggle). Errors: pass error (boolean) to get error styling, and the component must be used inside UiFormField for the error message itself to display.

Search bar: business.SearchBar (required: value, placeholder, onChange; onFilter adds the filter icon button). Filter panel: business.FilterSheet (required: visible, title, children, onClose; onConfirm runs before the sheet closes). Both import from '@/components/business/mobile'.

AuthRecoveryDialog, import from '@/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog'. No required props; mount it once near the app root — it subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders its view, returning null while no recovery event is pending. (Its inner view, common.AuthRecoveryDialogView from '@/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog-view', requires detail.)

notes: One search per task (5) + one get for task 2 = 6 catalog calls. Layer guesses: feature for tasks 1-2 (feature screens), shared-ui for tasks 3-5 (form/UI primitives and global dialog). All five searches matched their chosen layer directly, so --layer-fallback never had to retry; layerFallback was false for every task (no 'layerFallback' flag appeared in any search response).
